messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager duty: multiple containers in rwd-runtime-prod are CrashLoopBackOff on gpu-12; error rate on /v1/generate up to 18% — paging oncall.
emma: I'm on it, pulling logs now. seeing repeated segfaults in the runtime process inside container rwd-runtime: /opt/runtime/lib/runtime.so
mira: I got a repro trace from one failed pod: backtrace shows null pointer deref in fused_attention_plugin::forward at runtime/kernel_fuse.cpp:423
raj: which model? any customer impact? we have a retail customer complaining about 5xxs
kevin: Support: only a subset of hosted customers — ~12 tenants — hitting 500s; most traffic is fine. Affected model variant: rwd-turbo-embedding-v1 (quantized path)
luis: logs also show intermittent "CUDA error: invalid device pointer" right before the segfault on the same pods — might be memory reuse after free
emma: copying log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T17:05:22Z] runtime: fused_attention_plugin.cpp:423: void fused_attention(...): ASSERT(ptr != nullptr)
[2026-03-15T17:05:22Z] runtime: cuda: driver api error: invalid device pointer (700)
[2026-03-15T17:05:22Z] kernel: signal 11 (Segmentation fault) at 0x7ffdeadbeef
```
mira: thanks. probable root: recent fused kernel change in 2026-03-14 deploy (engine v2.13.1) — it introduced an early free under certain sequence lengths
raj: status of rollout? can we rollback quickly
emma: canary policy rolled to 30% last night; full rollout at 02:00 failed to auto-rollback. I'm going to pin traffic and roll back the engine image for production pods to v2.13.0 now
kevin: Support: communicating to impacted customers. Tagging affected customers list and giving ETA 15m for mitigation
luis: operational mitigations to reduce impact: scale replicas from 6->3 for that deployment, and set batch_size max to 8 to avoid the codepath that triggers free
mira: we'll also add an immediate pod selector to avoid gpu-12 (node flaps show gpu-12 highly loaded). run:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/rwd-runtime FORCE_IMAGE=v2.13.0
kubectl -n prod patch deploy/rwd-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"avoid":"gpu-12"}}}}}'
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/rwd-runtime --replicas=3
```
emma: doing the image pin now... applying patch
sre-bot: deploy event: rollout start rwd-runtime -> image:v2.13.0 by emma at 17:08 UTC
luis: also create a coredump from one crashing pod before it restarts; set /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern and copy core out. command:
```
kubectl exec -n prod rwd-runtime-crash-abc -- bash -lc 'echo /tmp/core.%e.%p > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern; kill -6 1'
kubectl cp prod/rwd-runtime-crash-abc:/tmp/core.rwd-runtime.123 /tmp/
```
mira: if we can get the core + nvprof logs that'll help. request: enable --save-kv-cache=false for quick mitigation too (might increase latency but reduce memory pressure)
emma: pinned, scaled, nodeSelector applied. pods are recycling
sre-bot: deploy event: rollout success rwd-runtime -> image:v2.13.0 by emma at 17:12 UTC
luis: pods are coming up on safe nodes; initial health checks passing, crashloop count dropping
kevin: Support update: customers seeing reduced errors, most restored. keeping customers patched with progress notes
raj: will open an incident doc for postmortem and link repro cases. assign to mira and luis for root cause and follow-up
mira: noted — I'll run the core through addr2line + ASAN build to pinpoint free-after-use. planning patch to guard nullptr and add extra cuda-memcheck tests in CI
emma: oncall handing off to raj for overnight watch. raj you're oncall now
raj: taking over. I'll keep the channel open for 2h then hand to next oncall. if anything worsens, escalate to eng-runtime
kevin: closing loop with customers in 30m once we confirm stability. thanks all :thumbsup:
sre-bot: incident summary: container crashloop due to null-deref in fused_attention after v2.13.1 deploy; mitigation: rollback to v2.13.0, scale down, isolate node gpu-12, collect core dumps. impact: partial 5xxs for ~12 tenants, degraded for ~18 minutes. owners: mira, luis, emma, raj
